messages:
Nina: Post-game-day quick notes: failover succeeded but we hit two surprising recurring things: (1) route propagation jitter causing brief request duplication, (2) ambiguous restore owner steps in the runbook. Dropping actionable follow-ups below.

Raj: Route jitter looked like transient ASN path changes combined with our aggressive traffic-swap script. I recommend adding a small quiesce window and a route-convergence check before swapping weights. Also we should emit a histogram metric 'routing.converge_ms' per-region.

Omar: During the restore rehearsal the playbook referenced an old bucket path and the operator paused to ask which snapshot to use. We need canonical backup naming in the runbook and a restore-id pattern plus checksum enforcement. I'll draft a checksum snippet for the runbook.

Priya: We also noticed that game-day runbooks are edited ad-hoc during a dry-run which makes rollbacks messy. Proposal: enforce a branch-per-edit policy and require two approvers on playbook PRs during the quarter after a game-day.

ops-bot: game-day-2026-05-10: summary posted; follow-ups created INF-540, INF-541, INF-542.

Nina: Concrete action items (please ack/reschedule if needed):
1) Routing: add converge histogram, quiesce gating, and extend traffic-swap to wait for p95 convergence < 3s for 30s window. Owner: Raj. Due: 2026-05-20. Ticket: INF-540.
2) Runbook backups: canonical naming + checksum enforcement and sample `aws s3 cp ... | sha256sum` snippet; add a restore-id step that writes a verification artifact to s3://dr-verifications/. Owner: Omar. Due: 2026-05-12. Ticket: INF-541.
3) Runbook process: require branch-per-change + two approvers for DR runbook edits for 90 days after each game-day. Owner: Priya. Due: 2026-05-05. Ticket: INF-542.

Sample checksum snippet for runbook preflight (include under "verify-backup"):
```
# pick candidate backup
export BACKUP=s3://redwood-backups/prod/20260510-0001.sql.gz
# checksum
aws s3 cp $BACKUP - | sha256sum
# write restore verification artifact after test restore
echo "restore-id: restore-$(date +%s)" > /tmp/restore-meta.txt
aws s3 cp /tmp/restore-meta.txt s3://dr-verifications/restore-$(date +%s).txt
```

Raj: ack. I'll add the metric and the gating logic. Will prototype a small patch to the traffic-swap script and link INF-540.

Omar: ack. I'll update playbook with canonical names and the checksum step, and add a short note about how to pick the snapshot when multiple exist. Will attach to INF-541.

Priya: ack. I'll update the repo protection rules and add a PR template that reminds editors to create a changelog entry. Linking INF-542.

Nina: One more small thing: schedule a short 30m follow-up in two weeks to validate changes in a narrow dry-run (no external customers). Proposed: 2026-05-24 14:00 UTC. Owner: Nina to create calendar invite by 2026-05-13.

Nina: Thanks all. I'll consolidate these into the game-day postmortem and close the loop in INF-540..INF-542. If more items appear, drop them here and ops-bot will append to tickets. :thumbsup:
